decisions.reason: Removing outer quotation marks from one Mama's Hot Take section does not change the existing requirement that callout text be italic.

The dedication update is already represented by the candidate's same-message INTRODUCE Event; the source MODIFY concerns quotation-mark and punctuation corrections and adds no further dedication state.
The copyedits do not designate a different authoritative manuscript source or alter the existing content-preservation rule.
The quotation-mark and punctuation corrections do not change any illustration selection, placement, sizing, or rendering requirement.
The identified copyedits are not stated to occur on the copyright page and do not change its content or layout requirements.
The source does not change Chapter 12 heading hierarchy, capitalization, or other chapter-heading typography.
The source does not address the interior title page or resolve its existing layout ambiguity.
Content punctuation corrections do not alter trim size, paragraph spacing, page density, or the general interior layout.
The source does not concern the book title or its literal newline artifact.
The manuscript copyedits do not change the paperback cover's content, dimensions, format, or review requirements.
